arStrings.szText: Your Movement Speed is increased by [{SF_31}*100|%+|] per stack.

While {c_important}Soulrift{/c} is active you are {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c} and gain {c_number}[SF_31*100|%+|]{/c} increased Movement Speed for every soul absorbed, up to {c_number}[SF_29|%+|]{/c}.

This bonus persists for {c_number}5{/c} seconds after {c_important}Soulrift{/c} ends.
{c_important}Soulrift{/c} is cast at the target location. Absorbing an enemy's soul deals {c_number}{payload:SOUL_ABSORB_DAMAGE}{/c} damage and Pulls them in.

{c_important}Soulrift{/c} deals Frostbite damage and {c_important}{u}Chills{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[{SF_27}|%|]{/c} every second. 

If {c_important}Soulrift{/c} absorbs the soul of a {c_important}{u}Frozen{/c}{/u} enemy, they shatter and explode for {c_number}{payload:FROZEN_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.
Every soul absorbed by {c_important}Soulrift{/c} increases its damage by {c_number}[{SF_14}*100|x%1|]{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_16}*{SF_14}*100|x%|]{/c}.

Every soul absorbed by {c_important}Soulrift{/c} grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[{SF_26} * 100|%1|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * SF_26)|0|]){/c}. 

This {c_important}{u}Barrier{/c}{/u} persists for {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} seconds after {c_important}Soulrift{/c} ends.

When {c_important}Soulrift{/c} absorbs an enemy's soul it makes them {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_18}{/c} seconds. 

After {c_important}Soulrift{/c} ends, all surrounding enemies are Feared and Slowed by {c_number}[{SF_30}|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_28}{/c} seconds.
Every {c_number}{SF_33}{/c} souls absorbed by {c_important}Soulrift{/c} grants {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/c}{/u}.
